/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program (California, focus year 2021)

    Question: Is it unlawful to evict a tenant because of their physical appearance?

    Statutes encoded (as provided):
      [1] CA Code Civ. Proc.  1161.4 (2021)  - immigration/citizenship-status based eviction prohibition
      [2] CA Ins. Code  12955 (2021)         - insurance proof-of-loss timing stay (not eviction-related)
      [3] CA Code Civ. Proc.  1161.3 (2021)  - DV/SA/stalking/HT/elder abuse victim protections re termination
      [4] CA Civ. Code  1946.8 (2021)        - no penalties (incl. termination) for summoning law enforcement/emergency assistance
*/

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Basic domain facts for this file
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

jurisdiction(california).
focus_year(2021).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Scenario facts (encode the question's factual statement)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% Parties
landlord(landlord1).
tenant(tenant1).

% The scenario: landlord is evicting tenant due to physical appearance.
eviction_attempt(landlord1, tenant1).
eviction_kind(landlord1, tenant1, cause_to_quit_involuntarily).
reason_for_eviction(landlord1, tenant1, physical_appearance).

% Scenario helper: succeeds exactly when the scenario facts are present.
scenario_statement :-
    jurisdiction(california),
    focus_year(2021),
    landlord(landlord1),
    tenant(tenant1),
    eviction_attempt(landlord1, tenant1),
    eviction_kind(landlord1, tenant1, cause_to_quit_involuntarily),
    reason_for_eviction(landlord1, tenant1, physical_appearance).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Statute [1]: CA Code Civ. Proc.  1161.4 (2021)
%% Prohibits causing tenant to quit involuntarily / action to recover possession
%% because of immigration/citizenship status (unless federal-program obligation).
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% For purposes of 1161.4, "immigration or citizenship status" includes perception/association.
statute_1161_4_immigration_or_citizenship_status(immigration_status).
statute_1161_4_immigration_or_citizenship_status(citizenship_status).
statute_1161_4_immigration_or_citizenship_status(perceived_immigration_status).
statute_1161_4_immigration_or_citizenship_status(perceived_citizenship_status).
statute_1161_4_immigration_or_citizenship_status(associated_with_person_of_immigration_status).
statute_1161_4_immigration_or_citizenship_status(associated_with_person_of_citizenship_status).

% Exception: landlord complying with federal rent-limit/rental-assistance program obligation.
% (No such facts are asserted in this scenario; predicate remains available.)
statute_1161_4_federal_program_obligation(_Landlord, _Tenant) :- fail.

% Core prohibition encoding (1161.4(a))
statute_1161_4_prohibits_eviction(Landlord, Tenant) :-
    eviction_attempt(Landlord, Tenant),
    eviction_kind(Landlord, Tenant, Kind),
    ( Kind = cause_to_quit_involuntarily
    ; Kind = action_to_recover_possession
    ),
    reason_for_eviction(Landlord, Tenant, Reason),
    statute_1161_4_immigration_or_citizenship_status(Reason),
    \+ statute_1161_4_federal_program_obligation(Landlord, Tenant).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Statute [2]: CA Ins. Code  12955 (2021)
%% Insurance policy lost/destroyed -> stays notice/proof-of-loss deadlines.
%% Not relevant to eviction unlawfulness here; encoded for completeness.
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% If a loss is sustained and the policy is lost/destroyed, deadlines are stayed
% from affidavit delivery until 5 days after commissioner delivers insurer affidavit.
% We model this as a generic rule; no scenario facts trigger it.
statute_12955_deadlines_stayed(_Applicant) :- fail.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Statute [3]: CA Code Civ. Proc.  1161.3 (2021)
%% Landlord shall not terminate or fail to renew based upon certain victimization,
%% if documented within 180 days AND perpetrator not a tenant of same unit.
%% Allows termination/decline renewal after protections if certain conditions (b).
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% Covered act types per 1161.3(a)
statute_1161_3_covered_act(domestic_violence).
statute_1161_3_covered_act(sexual_assault).
statute_1161_3_covered_act(stalking).
statute_1161_3_covered_act(human_trafficking).
statute_1161_3_covered_act(elder_or_dependent_adult_abuse).

% Documentation facts (placeholders; none asserted for scenario)
documented_covered_act_within_180_days(_Tenant, _ActType) :- fail.
perpetrator_not_tenant_same_unit(_Tenant, _Perpetrator) :- fail.

% Eviction/termination based on victimization act (placeholders; none asserted)
eviction_based_on_covered_act(_Landlord, _Tenant, _ActType) :- fail.
perpetrator_named(_Tenant, _Perpetrator) :- fail.

% Exception conditions allowing termination after protections (1161.3(b)) (placeholders)
tenant_allows_perpetrator_to_visit(_Tenant, _Perpetrator) :- fail.
landlord_reasonably_believes_threat(_Landlord, _Perpetrator) :- fail.
landlord_gave_three_day_notice_to_correct(_Landlord, _Tenant) :- fail.

statute_1161_3_exception_allows_termination(Landlord, Tenant) :-
    perpetrator_named(Tenant, Perpetrator),
    ( tenant_allows_perpetrator_to_visit(Tenant, Perpetrator)
    ; landlord_reasonably_believes_threat(Landlord, Perpetrator)
    ),
    landlord_gave_three_day_notice_to_correct(Landlord, Tenant).

% Core prohibition encoding (1161.3(a), with (b) carveout)
statute_1161_3_prohibits_termination(Landlord, Tenant) :-
    eviction_attempt(Landlord, Tenant),
    eviction_based_on_covered_act(Landlord, Tenant, ActType),
    statute_1161_3_covered_act(ActType),
    documented_covered_act_within_180_days(Tenant, ActType),
    perpetrator_named(Tenant, Perpetrator),
    perpetrator_not_tenant_same_unit(Tenant, Perpetrator),
    \+ statute_1161_3_exception_allows_termination(Landlord, Tenant).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Statute [4]: CA Civ. Code  1946.8 (2021)
%% Landlord shall not impose/threaten penalties (incl. termination/failure to renew)
%% because tenant/resident/person summoned law enforcement/emergency assistance.
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% "Penalties" include termination or failure to renew (1946.8(a)(3)(B)).
statute_1946_8_penalty(terminate_tenancy).
statute_1946_8_penalty(fail_to_renew).
statute_1946_8_penalty(threaten_terminate_tenancy).
statute_1946_8_penalty(threaten_fail_to_renew).
statute_1946_8_penalty(inferior_terms_conditions).
statute_1946_8_penalty(fees_fines_penalties).

% Placeholder facts: none asserted in scenario
summoned_law_enforcement_or_emergency(_Summoner, _OnBehalfOf) :- fail.
landlord_imposed_penalty(_Landlord, _Tenant, _PenaltyType) :- fail.
penalty_based_on_summoning(_Landlord, _Tenant) :- fail.

% Core prohibition encoding (1946.8(c))
statute_1946_8_prohibits_penalty(Landlord, Tenant) :-
    landlord_imposed_penalty(Landlord, Tenant, PenaltyType),
    statute_1946_8_penalty(PenaltyType),
    penalty_based_on_summoning(Landlord, Tenant),
    ( summoned_law_enforcement_or_emergency(Tenant, Tenant)
    ; summoned_law_enforcement_or_emergency(_OtherPerson, Tenant)
    ).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Reasoning: determine whether the scenario eviction is unlawful under provided statutes
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

eviction_unlawful_under_provided_statutes :-
    scenario_statement,
    ( statute_1161_4_prohibits_eviction(landlord1, tenant1)
    ; statute_1161_3_prohibits_termination(landlord1, tenant1)
    ; statute_1946_8_prohibits_penalty(landlord1, tenant1)
    ).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Answer predicate (deterministic): housing_answer(yes|no)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

housing_answer(yes) :-
    eviction_unlawful_under_provided_statutes,
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Main entrypoint
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Is it unlawful to evict a tenant because of their physical appearance?
